summary: Frontend regression test of 5 surgical changes (ongoing year 2027, hero/SelectedWork Casa+Griffin removal, Projects square-vs-portrait cards, About founder equal sizing, Footer logo aspect fix) + responsive sweep. All 5 changes verified passing on desktop, tablet and mobile. Zero console errors across all pages.
verified_changes: Ongoing year 2027: /projects/my-dream-aurelia and /projects/my-dream-ivy both display 2027 with 'ongoing' meta; /projects/my-dream-nest still shows 2020 + 'Sold Out & Occupied' — no regression.
Our Map sidebar rows for all 6 ongoing (Aurelia, Elysium, Aura, Echelon, Vale, Ivy) show 'ONGOING · 2027'; completed rows still show correct years (2020..2026). Map data source verified.

Home hero slideshow: hero-slide-my-dream-casa and hero-slide-my-dream-griffin selectors do NOT exist in DOM (both null). Carousel currently mounts 2 active slides at a time from the 6-slide order, so only 2 testids visible at any moment which is expected behavior for a rolling carousel; no Casa/Griffin ever mounted.

Selected Work section: data-testid='selected-work' present with exactly 3 cards in order: project-card-my-dream-nest, project-card-my-dream-hillock, project-card-my-dream-solace. No Casa, no Griffin, no empty slots.
Casa/Griffin regression: /projects grid still contains project-card-my-dream-casa and project-card-my-dream-griffin; /projects/my-dream-casa detail page loads with 'Casa' content.

Projects card aspect ratios (measured at desktop 1920):
  - All 10 completed cards visible (Nest, Casa, Avasa, Skylark, Glenmore, Hillock, Summit, Griffin, Zenith, Solace): 480x480 ratio 1.00 (square).
  - All 6 ongoing cards (Aurelia, Ivy, Elysium, Aura, Echelon, Vale): 480x600 ratio 0.80 (4:5 portrait).

About founder portraits desktop (1920): founder-sai-portrait 352x440, founder-akhil-portrait 352x440 — EXACTLY EQUAL. object-position on both = '50% 45%' (face not cropped). Tablet 834: both 352x440 EQUAL.
Footer logo: rendered 192.0 x 135.9 ratio 1.413 = natural 2229x1578 ratio 1.413 exact match. No flex-stretch distortion.

responsive.tablet_834: No horizontal overflow on /about; founders both 352x440 identical.
responsive.mobile_390: No horizontal overflow on /projects or /about; founders 355x444 and 348x435 (both maintain ~4:5 ratio; 7px width difference between stacked cards is likely a container/padding artifact — cosmetic only, not functional). No layout breakage.

console_errors: Zero errors across /, /projects, /about, /contact, /projects/my-dream-nest (also verified on /project-map load).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor mobile observation: on /about at 390px, founder-sai-portrait renders 355x444 while founder-akhil-portrait renders 348x435 (7px width delta). Since both maintain aspect-[4/5] correctly, this is likely due to different parent flex-basis or a stray margin/padding on the Sai column at the sm breakpoint. Not blocking, but if visual symmetry is desired on mobile, worth investigating parent width.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 surgical changes for iteration 39 verified via preview URL https://premium-residential-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Only cosmetic note: mobile founder cards differ by 7px width (both retain 4:5 ratio). Hero slideshow uses rolling mount (2 slides in DOM at a time from 6-slide order) — do not expect 6 testids simultaneously; instead assert casa/griffin are never present.
